admission.justification: On the stacked layout the reading area sits below a tall family tree: this leaf's Worker's narrow probe of 2026-10-06 measured the selected subject's answer beginning 11,849 pixels below an 844-pixel viewport (notes/reports/role-launch/260928-MIK-L39-worker-f1a6fcad-303f-4dc4-9a24-12bc5b1a6a7e-evidence/post-sync-2026-10-06/narrow-geometry.json, cited by OR-R033). The reveal is realized in the workspace's focus path and pinned by mounted cases over the real captured bodies.

applicability: The mounted intent reviewer's reading area after a selection of a row the family tree shows, on the stacked layout (60rem and narrower), while the read is answered.
conditions: The selection is in-tree: a family or member row of the tree, the visible previous-change and next-change controls, `j`, `k`, a member opened from the reading area's member list, or a kept family's continuation control.
The reveal focuses the selected row without scrolling to it and scrolls the start of the reading area into view, in the answer of that selection.
Every other selection and every wider layout keeps the scrolling behavior it had before the ruling; the explicit Jump control remains for the callers OR-R033 leaves unchanged.
exclusions: A read that ends failed or refused; its status reveal is the subject of INV-BMFR2T.
A reader who moved focus while the read was on its way: no later answer scrolls or takes focus.
A refresh's scroll request and a lane or file destination's reveal, which keep their own rules.

evidence: browser/final-vs-pre.json (36 of 36 answered in-tree activations at 390 revealed; 62 of 62 steps at 1600 unchanged); mutations D1-a to D1-f

statement: On the stacked layout (60rem and narrower) the answer of an in-tree selection scrolls the start of the reading area into view and puts focus on the selected row without scrolling to it; every other selection and every wider layout scrolls as before.
